name: Synapse
subtitle: The ML System Design Atlas
heroH1:
Design ML systems
that learn & ship
models that hold up.
heroLede: Work the machine-learning design interview end to end \u2014 turning a fuzzy business goal into a measurable ML objective, choosing features and models you can defend, and serving predictions inside a real latency budget. Then walk seven full problem breakdowns, graded Naive \u2192 Solid \u2192 Standout.
featLabs: Tune a precision/recall guardrail, walk a two-tower retrieval index, watch feature drift bend a live metric, size an inference budget, and grade your own objective against the Naive/Solid/Standout ladder.
pathBanner: Pick MLSD Foundations, Modelling Depth, Serving & Operations, or Breakdown Drills and copy the path as Markdown study notes.

paths.title: MLSD Foundations
paths.label: Foundations
paths.desc: The interview shape, the six-phase framework, and how a business goal becomes an ML objective you can measure.

paths.title: Modelling Depth
paths.label: Modelling
paths.desc: Embeddings, features, training pipelines, generalization, and the metrics that decide whether any of it worked.

paths.title: Serving & Operations
paths.label: Serving
paths.desc: Two-stage retrieval, inference architecture, drift monitoring, and closing the feedback loop without poisoning it.

paths.title: Breakdown Drills
paths.label: Breakdowns
paths.desc: Seven full walkthroughs, each graded Naive / Solid / Standout with an explicit mid, senior and staff bar.
